main.name: Dr. Simon Hung
main.title: Chairman, ORTV & IAA
main.bio: Elder Simon Hung dedicated his early years to the Bread of Life Multimedia, pioneering gospel films, music, and media ministry — earning recognition as a trailblazer in Chinese evangelical arts and media missions. After stepping down as president in 2019, he has continued to champion gospel media development and currently serves as Chairman of the Christian Tribune.

main.name: Dr. Timothy Cheng
main.title: International Executive Director, IAA
main.bio: Currently serving as President of the Christian Tribune and Executive Director of Impact Asia Center, Dr. Cheng leads media and church renewal through innovative and transformative thinking. He guided the Tribune through its digital transformation, expanding news, commentary, and lifestyle content into a vital public platform for the Chinese church. At Impact Asia Center, he actively builds cross-national church exchange and cooperation networks, spreading faith ideals broadly across Asia with far-reaching influence.

coChairs.name: Rev. Mike Constantz
coChairs.title: Saddleback Church
coChairs.bio: Pastor of Global Missions at Saddleback Church and one of Pastor Rick Warren's most trusted colleagues, overseeing the church's global missions and community development work. He is the chief architect and executive leader of the PEACE Plan — a movement that mobilizes ordinary people in ordinary places to do extraordinary things, uniting churches worldwide to address five global giants: poverty, disease, illiteracy, injustice, and spiritual emptiness. His expertise lies in training churches to partner with local governments and businesses in tri-sector collaboration, transforming missions from short-term visits into long-term, sustainable community transformation — a model that has influenced tens of thousands of churches globally.

coChairs.name: Rev. John Heston
coChairs.title: First Baptist Church Tempe
coChairs.bio: Dr. John Heston serves as FBC's Senior Pastor. He is a seasoned Pastor with over 25 years of experience in church leadership. He is committed to shepherding individuals to Christ, engaging the community in local and global outreach and has a strong focus on discipleship. Pastor Heston began serving at FBC on May 6, 2024 along with his wife Stacy and their 4 children, Ethan, Olivia, Lucas and Wesley.

coChairs.name: Rev. Ryan Nunez
coChairs.title: Palm Valley Church
coChairs.bio: Senior Pastor of Palm Valley Church (PVC) in Arizona, one of the fastest-growing and largest churches in the West Valley of Phoenix, with multiple campuses including Goodyear and Buckeye. Known for a practical, life-applicable teaching style, he excels at translating deep biblical truth into everyday guidance that people can understand and apply. His goal is to help people encounter God in real life and find the motivation to move forward through life's challenges.

coChairs.name: Rev. Paulus Wong
coChairs.title: IAA Malaysian Convener
coChairs.bio: Senior Pastor of the Chinese congregation at Grace Community Church Seremban, IAA Malaysia Convener, Chinese Chairman of the National Evangelical Christian Fellowship (NECF), and Chairman of the Chinese Global Leadership Summit (GLS) Malaysia.

coChairs.name: Rev. Yoshiko Ito
coChairs.title: Shiroi-ie Fellowship Church
coChairs.bio: Rev. Yoshiko Ito serves as the Senior Pastor of the Shiroi-ie Fellowship Church in Okinawa and Principal of the affiliated Shiroi-ie Christian School. She also hosts the Okinawa gospel radio program "Yoshiko Ito's Beautiful Gift," chairs the Okinawa Executive Committee for the TV program "Lifeline," and leads the NPO "Father's House," which provides day care and after-school services. Her ministry spans church, education, media, and social welfare, with tireless dedication to the expansion of God's Kingdom at home and abroad.

coChairs.name: Rev. John Cheng
coChairs.title: Board Member, Impact Asia Center
coChairs.bio: Advisor Pastor of Wuchang Church in Kaohsiung, having served as Senior Pastor for many years and leading the congregation from hundreds to thousands, while establishing a solid elder-led governance system and discipleship training framework. He served as Chairman of the Kaohsiung Pastoral Fellowship Prayer Meeting and is recognized as one of the "Spiritual Elders of Kaohsiung," championing cross-denominational unity through citywide prayer altars and evangelistic movements that have profoundly shaped church cohesion in the region. A proponent of "city transformation" and "workplace missions," he emphasizes the church's engagement with society, and in recent years has been actively involved with Impact Asia Center, helping connect leaders across sectors to advance cross-border missions and a kingdom vision.
